result.planSummary: Realigned artifact review to process-scoped context by authorizing artifact review from current process refs plus current package-context pins, removing produced-by-process fallback from review target discovery, preserving package member rendering through pinned-version lookups, and fixing the stale explicit version client path so version-selection failures reload the review workspace into a bounded unavailable state instead of collapsing the workspace shell.

changedFiles.reason: Changed `selectArtifactVersion` to reload the review workspace with the same explicit selection when stale version lookups fail, preserving bounded unavailable target state instead of setting a fatal workspace error.
Changed artifact review eligibility from current refs or produced-by-process to current refs or current package-context pins, and added a pinned-version lookup path for package review rendering.
Switched selected package member rendering to the new version-specific artifact review helper so package review stays intact after the process-scope tightening.
Updated Convex and in-memory review target discovery to source artifact targets from current refs plus current package-context members, omitting produced-only artifacts and zero-version targets.
Clarified the bounded zero-version artifact review copy for direct empty-state review.
Added client coverage proving stale explicit version failures reload the workspace into bounded unavailable state instead of collapsing the shell.
Added server coverage for package-context-pinned artifact targets and zero-version omission from default review target discovery.

Added server coverage for cross-process current/prior version review, pinned-context review access, unrelated produced-only artifacts staying unavailable, and explicit version requests against zero-version artifacts.
Added client coverage for the bounded zero-version direct review state.
Added client API coverage to preserve ARTIFACT_VERSION_NOT_FOUND from artifact review responses.
Updated the zero-version panel expectation to the new bounded empty-state copy.
Registered package-context Convex handlers and updated integration coverage to the new process-context review rules while preserving package review behavior.

gatesRun.command: corepack pnpm exec vitest run tests/service/client/version-switcher.test.ts tests/service/client/review-workspace-page.test.ts --environment jsdom

findingsFixed: Removed the produced-by-process fallback that kept unrelated artifacts reviewable after they fell out of the current process context.
Added package-context-pinned artifact eligibility for both workspace target discovery and direct artifact review.
Preserved package review selected-member rendering by resolving pinned versions through a context-free version helper instead of the tightened direct artifact eligibility path.
Covered zero-version edge cases end to end: omitted from default targets, bounded empty direct review state, and exact ARTIFACT_VERSION_NOT_FOUND for explicit version requests.

Fixed verifier finding SV-03-01 by making stale explicit version selection reload the review workspace with bounded unavailable target state instead of setting `reviewWorkspace.error` and collapsing the shell.

Confirmed Story 3 obligations are covered in implementation or tests: current-ref and pinned-context reviewability, cross-process earlier-version selection, zero-version default omission, zero-version direct empty state, exact request-level version-not-found classification, and bounded client fallback for stale explicit version selection.
findingsSurfaced: No story-specific production-path shim or placeholder remains; the only residual scaffolds observed are the repo-wide pre-existing `guard:no-test-changes` skip and scaffolded `test:e2e` lane, which were not introduced or widened by this story.

result.recommendedNextStep: Hand the story to verification/QA for focused review of Story 3 acceptance criteria, with explicit retest of stale explicit version selection to confirm the workspace shell now stays readable with bounded unavailable state.
